minor.issue: rank_progress treats a 0 requirement as 100% (min_team=0 for Bronze), so Members with 0 direct / 0 team display 50% progress to Bronze. Exclude zero-requirement components from the average (or weight by non-zero criteria).
N+1 queries: team_counts (2 count queries) + team_volume per user for up to 1000 users on every request; will be slow at scale. Consider aggregation or caching.

Only clears login_attempts whose identifier ends with the user's email; a lockout on the mobile identifier (ip:+CCmobile) is not cleared, so a user locked out via mobile login stays locked after admin reset.
Does not set password_changed_at (admin_set_password does) - inconsistent audit data.

ui_bugs.issue: Switching directly Hindi -> Bengali keeps the page in Hindi. Google Translate itself writes googtrans='/en/hi' on the parent domain (.emergentagent.com; on prod would be the registrable domain). setCookie only writes host + domain=hostname, so the stale parent-domain cookie wins. Observed cookies after switch: [('/en/hi','.emergentagent.com'), ('/en/bn','.sim-finance-hub...'), ('/en/hi','sim-finance-hub...')]. Fix: in setCookie, also write/expire googtrans for every parent domain suffix of location.hostname (e.g. loop over hostname.split('.') suffixes with length>=2), and expire before setting new value.

LangSwitcher is only in the 'hidden lg:flex' desktop block and not in the mobile menu; auth pages have no switcher. A mobile visitor who picked বাংলা/हिन्दी in the first-visit picker cannot switch back on public pages without logging in. Add LangSwitcher to the mobile-menu and auth layout.
